Privacy Policy

Last updated October 8, 2026

Overview

Epoch Tasks ("the app") is a personal task-tracking app provided by its developer ("we", "us"). This policy explains what information the app handles, where it is stored, and what the third-party services the app uses may collect.

In short: everything you create in Epoch Tasks stays on your device. We run no server, offer no accounts, and never receive your tasks, notes or files.

Information you create

Tasks, tags, notes, due dates and times (including the time zone a task was created in), notification settings, app settings, and any photos or files you attach are stored only on your device, inside the app's private storage. Attached photos and files are copies of items you choose yourself through the system picker.

We cannot see, access, back up or recover this information. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data deletes it from the device.

Settings → Export Data lets you save your own backup file, and Import Data restores from one. Where you store an exported file (for example a cloud drive) is your choice and governed by that service's terms.

Android device backup

If you have turned on Android's device backup, Android may include the app's data in the backup saved to your Google account and restore it when you reinstall the app. This is a feature of Android, operated by Google under your Google account settings — we never receive that data. You can turn device backup off in your Android settings.

Notifications

If you add notifications to a task, or keep the daily summary on (a 9:00 AM notification listing what's due), the app schedules them locally on your device using Android's alarm and notification system. No notification data is sent to us or to any server. You can turn the daily summary off in Settings, and all notifications off in your Android settings.

Permissions the app uses

Notifications — to show the task reminders you add. Alarms & reminders (exact alarms) — so reminders can fire on time; if you don't allow it, Android may deliver them later. Vibration — for haptic feedback.

Photos and files — only the specific items you choose in the system picker; the app has no general access to your photos or files.

Internet and network state — used only by the advertising and in-app purchase services described below; your task data is never sent over the network.

Advertising

The free version of Epoch Tasks may show ads served by Google AdMob. To serve and measure ads, Google and its partners may collect your device's advertising ID, general device and app information, your IP address (used to estimate approximate location), and ad interaction data.

Where required by law — including for users in the EEA, UK and Switzerland — the app asks for your consent before personalized ads are shown; if you decline, non-personalized ads are shown. You can reset your advertising ID or opt out of ad personalization at any time in your Android settings.

Google's use of this data is governed by Google's own policies: https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites

In-app purchase

The optional one-time "Remove Ads" purchase is processed entirely by Google Play. We never receive or store your payment details; Google tells the app only whether the purchase is valid.

What we don't do

We don't require an account, and we don't collect your name, email address, contacts, location or files. We don't sell your personal information, and we don't use analytics or tracking of our own.

Security

Your data is protected by your device's own security (screen lock, encryption). No method of electronic storage is perfectly secure, and keeping your device secure is your responsibility.

Children

Epoch Tasks is not directed at children under 13 (or the minimum age required in your country), and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Your rights

Because we hold no personal data about you, there is nothing for us to access, correct or delete on your behalf — your data is on your device and under your control (export it, edit it, or delete it by clearing the app's data or uninstalling). For data collected by Google for advertising or purchases, use your Google account and Android settings or contact Google. Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR or California law) you may have additional rights; you can contact us with any privacy question.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy as the app changes. The date at the top will change, and material changes will be noted in the app's release notes.
